---
description: 'Turn a high-level idea into a Beads epic with ready-to-implement deliverable chunks.'
---

Follow the instructions in `.github/skills/beads-plan/SKILL.md` exactly, and do not
begin until you have read that file.

The workflow lives in the skill rather than here because Copilot CLI discovers
`.github/skills/` but not `.github/prompts/`. This file exists so the same workflow is
available as `/beads-plan` in VS Code. The skill is the single source of truth; this
pointer must never grow into a second copy of it.
